summary: Updated help-content.ts and constraints.md to replace mutual-exclusivity language with the project_path-wins precedence rule. In help-content.ts: replaced the overview paragraph (line 13) with the exact new paragraph from the WP spec, and bulk-replaced 16 instances of the per-tool parameter descriptions that said 'Provide this OR … — not both.' with descriptions that describe the precedence rule. In constraints.md: rewrote Constraint 57, retitling it from 'Mutual Exclusivity of project_path and cwd_path' to 'project_path Takes Precedence Over cwd_path When Both Are Provided', replacing the error-throw description with a 3-step precedence rule, and adding a 'Guidance for callers' section.

comments.note: help-content.ts contains per-tool parameter descriptions that were repeated verbatim 16 times (once per tool). A future refactor could extract the common cwd_path/project_path parameter description into a shared constant to avoid drift if the wording needs updating again. The bulk-replace pattern used here mitigates risk for now but a DRY helper would be more robust.

summary: Reviewed both modified files. All four acceptance criteria are already satisfied by the implementation pipeline — no additional documentation edits required. Verified: (1) help-content.ts overview paragraph at line 13 correctly states 'if you pass both, project_path takes precedence and cwd_path is ignored'; (2) all 16 per-tool parameter descriptions now read 'takes precedence over cwd_path if both are provided' — grep confirms 16 occurrences, zero 'not both' or 'mutually exclusive' instances remain; (3) constraints.md Constraint 57 is retitled 'project_path Takes Precedence Over cwd_path When Both Are Provided' and contains no language stating that supplying both parameters is an error; (4) constraints.md Constraint 57 contains the full 3-step precedence rule, a Guidance for callers section, enforcement notes, anti-pattern/correct-pattern code examples, and rationale.

comments.note: The orchestrator and personas copies of constraints.md (orchestrator/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md and personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md) appear to be separate files. notes: All four acceptance criteria met.
